title: Section 14 CPC — Presumption as to foreign judgments

content.overview: Section 14 CPC raises a presumption that a produced certified copy of a foreign judgment was pronounced by a competent court. The presumption is rebuttable by proving want of jurisdiction.
content.study: Section 14 is an evidence rule, not an enforcement shortcut. Section 13 still decides whether the foreign judgment is conclusive. Produce the certified copy, then meet or displace the competence presumption. Do not skip the Section 13 exceptions.
